text:
The net yield of ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 per glucose: phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase each form 2 ATP (4 total), and the investment phase consumes 2. A glucosyl unit from glycogen yields a net of 3, because phosphorolysis bypasses the hexokinase step and only one ATP is spent at phosphofructokinase-1.
CONFIDENCE: 90
